description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It manages the process of associating specific versions of test cases with multiple test plans, including retrieving test case details, linked versions, and associated test plans, and rendering a web interface for these operations.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Creates an object containing request and session parameters for use in processing the page, specifically test plan and project IDs, and test case IDs.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes and returns a GUI object with properties for rendering the page, such as title, description, and actions.

search-terms: assign test case to test plans
